name: Memory MCP
tagline: A local knowledge graph the agent can remember with.
description: Reference MCP server that stores entities, relations, and observations in a local JSONL graph. Lets a client persist facts across chats without a remote database. Published as @modelcontextprotocol/server-memory.
author: Model Context Protocol (LF Projects)
notes: Set MEMORY_FILE_PATH to keep the graph outside the package directory.
